# DaKnowledge

> Curated Catholic theology knowledge base. The human website is free; agents use a paid x402 HTTP API for machine-readable retrieval with citations.

## Human site (free)

- [Home](https://belongarobert.github.io/DaKnowledge/): doctrine, study paths, search
- [Developers / agents](https://belongarobert.github.io/DaKnowledge/study/developers/): how to call the x402 API
- [Sources](https://belongarobert.github.io/DaKnowledge/sources/): bibliography and primary sources

## Agent API (x402 — paid retrieval)

Base URL: https://daknowledge-x402.onrender.com

Free discovery (no payment):

- GET / — JSON catalog
- GET /.well-known/x402.json — x402 agent catalog (services, prices, schemas)
- GET /.well-known/agent.json — agent card with skills and demo links
- GET /openapi.json — OpenAPI 3.1
- GET /health — health check
- GET /v1/stats — index statistics
- Any /v1 route with ?demo=1 — free truncated preview (same JSON shape as paid)

Paid routes ($0.05 USDC each on Base mainnet):

- GET /v1/ask?q= — cited answer from the index (start here)
- GET /v1/search?q= — full-text search
- GET /v1/document?path= — fetch one document
- GET /v1/topic/:topic — documents by topic
- GET /v1/scripture?ref= — pages citing a verse
- GET /v1/ccc?n= — pages citing a Catechism paragraph

Unpaid calls return HTTP 402 with a PAYMENT-REQUIRED header. Agents pay via x402 (USDC on Base).

## How agents find this service

1. Crawl https://daknowledge-x402.onrender.com/.well-known/x402.json
2. Agent card: https://daknowledge-x402.onrender.com/.well-known/agent.json
3. Free demo: append ?demo=1 to any /v1 route
4. Search Coinbase CDP Bazaar: https://api.cdp.coinbase.com/platform/v2/x402/discovery/search?query=DaKnowledge
5. Connect to Bazaar MCP: https://api.cdp.coinbase.com/platform/v2/x402/discovery/mcp
6. x402 List: https://x402-list.com/services?q=DaKnowledge

## Recommended agent workflow

1. Preview free: GET /v1/ask?q=hypostatic+union&demo=1
2. Paid pull: GET /v1/ask?q=hypostatic+union ($0.05 USDC)
3. If you need more context: GET /v1/search?q=... then GET /v1/document?path=...
4. For verse or CCC lookups: GET /v1/scripture?ref=John+1:14 or GET /v1/ccc?n=234

Answers cite Scripture, the Catechism, and source document paths — not a generic LLM.

## Topics covered

Trinity, Christology, Pneumatology, Soteriology, Ecclesiology, Mariology, Sacraments, Scripture, Moral theology, Eschatology, Prayer, Relics, and more.
